'''2011 Bespin Regionals Ian C. DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ian C.]] at [[2011 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Boys and Toys
* '''Username:''' Runner
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
